content: nekanixewaɨritɨaka 'uka pemanayexeiyarie 'aniwema meta, yurikɨ nekanixenaki'erieka ―ne xeikɨa pɨkatixaɨ, matsi tanaitɨ temeitima tita yuri mɨraine tepɨxenaki'erie―,
tita yuri mɨraine tahetsie mɨyekakɨ meta, mɨtatsiteɨtakɨ yuheyemekɨ:

Kakaɨyari ta'ukiyari, Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu ta'ukiyari nu'aya, yurikɨ me'utiyuatɨ meteyukanaki'erietɨ, 'aixɨa mekete'u'iyarini xehetsiemieme, mekexenenimayaka, mekexepitɨaka yu'iyaritsie xemɨka'uximatɨariekakɨ.
Waɨkawa nepɨnetemawiekai nemɨtimariekɨ 'aniwema hipatɨ tita yuri mɨrainetsie metewiyatɨ memu'uwakɨ, 'aitsika ta'ukiyari hetsɨa mieme ketemɨte'upitɨarie.
Hikɨri 'uka hekwamekɨ nemati'aitɨatɨ nepɨkamati'utɨirie, mɨkɨ 'aitsika tsutɨapai temeixeiyakai nepɨmati'utɨirie pɨta. 'Ipaɨ nepɨmatiwawirie, tanaitɨ temɨtanaki'eriekakɨ.
'Ipaɨ tekateniyurieka xɨka teteyukanaki'erieka: yatepɨteyurieka kemɨti'aita. 'Ikɨ kani'aitsikatɨni: xeteyukanaki'erietɨ xemu'uwanikɨ, tsutɨapai kexemɨte'u'enana.

Yumɨiretɨ te'itawamete mekaneutayeixɨani kwiepa, mɨkɨ mepɨkatehekɨata kename Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu tewi matɨatsie metewiya. Kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ mɨtiyuriene mɨkɨ ti'itawame meta Kɨritsitu maye'unie kanihɨkɨtɨni.
Xekeneyukweriwayurieka kapa xeheiyehɨanikɨ ta'uximayatsika, matsi yu'iwarika naime xemɨpitɨarienikɨ.

Yunaitɨ memanuyehaitɨrɨwe, tita Kɨritsitu mɨti'ɨkitatsie metewiyatɨ memɨkayuhayewa, mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari mepɨkahexeiya. Kemɨ'ane tita mɨti'ɨkitatsie tiwiyatɨ mɨyuhayewa, mɨkɨ yu'ukiyari pexeiya meta nu'aya.
Xewitɨ xɨka xehetsɨa nuani 'ikɨ 'ɨkitsika kahexeiyatɨ, xepɨka'i'inieka yukie meta xepɨka'iwaɨritɨaka.
Tsepanetɨ waɨkawa nemɨtixetaxatɨanikeyu, nepɨkanewaɨriya xapatsie nemɨtixehaka'utɨirienikɨ. Matsitsɨ xehetsɨa nepeuyeimɨkɨ pɨta, tahɨxie te'utinenieretɨ temɨtetaxatakɨ maye'anikɨ tatemawierika.
'A'iwa 'uka manayexeiyarie niwemama mepɨmatsiwaɨritɨa. Mɨpaɨ xeikɨa kani'aneni.
